memo: New part: fixed-slot de novo. Same CPU build as e2dn-1 (public 0.420 base, Apache-2.0, huseyinemreaksoy v4n fusion + our fp2 + MMP 100 + our dn1 de novo, 16 samples/spectrum, 150 min cap), plus ours: after the fusion, the top de novo row (our fp2 log-likelihood order) is moved to final slot 3 for library-weak molecules (engine lib_max < 0.7), the way the public v3 line slots PubChem-only proposals (2,4,6..) instead of letting the ranker place them. Reason: the ranker was trained without de novo rows (no library/analog support) and can bury them; offline, fp2 puts the truth at de novo rank 1 for 7 of 11 molecules where dn1 made it. Hypothesis: LB > e2dn-1 (ranker-placed de novo); compare to e2b-2 0.381.
message: e2dnsl-1: e2dn-1 + top de novo row at slot 3 when lib_max<0.7 (ours). Hypothesis: LB > e2dn-1
